_note: Word-error-rate test set for the Montenegrin speech-to-text provider (internal quality metric, shown on the institutions' dashboard through /api/kpi/quality). THESE FIVE SAMPLES ARE SYNTHETIC STAND-INS: the audio is a plain tone and the 'recognised' text comes from a fixture file, so the figure measures the pipeline, not a real recogniser. Real consented recordings of elderly Montenegrin speakers must replace them before the pitch — see docs/samples/README.md. Each fixture transcript deliberately differs from the reference by one or two words, the way an elderly speaker is actually mis-recognised, so the WER is visibly non-zero.
